title: Puttering Pebble-Puffer
statement: Beneath the warm amber glow of a sunken glass lantern and drifting emerald kelp, this round, wide-eyed puffer spends its days nudging bits of sea-glass and slate pebbles into intricate mandalas across the silver sand. Whenever a stray current scatters its latest design, it simply blinks, blows a cheerful little bubble ring of its own, and starts weaving a brand-new pattern.
